A second act for spironolactone: cognitive benefits in renal dysfunction - a critical review. Renal dysfunction or Chronic kidney disease (CKD) are increasingly associated with cognitive deficit and memory impairment, suggesting a crucial kidney-brain axis. This review examines spironolactone's emerging role as a neuroprotective agent in the context of renal dysfunction-induced cognitive impairment.
